system.description: A sixth sense for threats: each level gives an extra Combat Pool die and lets the adept spend Combat Pool to assist the Reaction Test in surprise situations (p.86). Level 1 costs 2, level 2 costs 3, level 3 costs 4. SR2E p.125.
system.notes: SR2E p.125 (Combat Sense Power table): level 1 = +1 Combat Pool die for 2, level 2 = +2 for 3, level 3 = +3 for 4. Combat Pool dice may assist surprise Reaction Tests (p.86).
